Come as you are
Children · Young adults · SEN & disabilities

Care that starts with understanding.

Hello, I'm Issy. Safe & Sound Care is a team of support workers helping children and young adults with special needs and disabilities. It's built on a simple idea: everyone is different, and the best support begins by getting to know the person in front of you.

Our team offers person-centred care and support, creating safe, inclusive experiences where each child and young adult can feel comfortable, supported and entirely themselves.

There's no one-size-fits-all here. Your needs, your preferences and your strengths shape everything we do together.

Support designed around you.

Our support workers help children and young adults with special needs and disabilities, whether that's one-to-one support, a social group or a dance class.

Qualified, caring and committed.

Training and checks that sit behind every session, so families can feel confident from the first hello.

  • Autism Training
  • Safeguarding Children with SEN
  • Positive Behaviour Support (PBS) Trained
  • Enhanced DBS on Update Service
  • First Aid Trained
  • ISTD Trained Dance Teacher
  • Mental Health for Children Training
  • Level 5 in Social, Emotional and Cognitive Development in Children
